title: Local auxiliary witness
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $m$, and $r$ query positions, and let $K$ be a natural number. Given a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with $K$ clauses, a Boolean input word of length $n$, a Boolean proof word of length $m$, and a verifier seed, define a sign assignment on the $K$ auxiliary variables as follows: if the verifier accepts the local transcript obtained from the input and proof at that seed, choose an auxiliary assignment witnessing satisfiability of the seed’s formula; otherwise assign the sign $-1$ to every auxiliary variable.
